statements.status_notes: Rundeck 6.2.1 ships spring-webmvc 6.2.19 inside rundeck.war via the Grails 7.1 / Spring Framework 6.2 BOM. Docker Scout and GitHub advisories list no patched release on the 6.2.x line; the first published fix is spring-webmvc 7.0.9, which is a major Spring Framework upgrade incompatible with this Grails line without a coordinated upstream Rundeck release. Assessment of reachability and a safe upgrade path is ongoing.
